iteration_0.solution: Calibrate influence dynamics, perhaps by increasing the influence factor or adjusting intervention timing, to better match real-world data.

iteration_0.impact: Without comprehensive visualizations, it is difficult to assess and communicate the dynamics of mask adoption over time.
iteration_0.solution: Enhance visualization methods to include time series plots and detailed adoption rate displays per demographic group.
